caseName: Consumer Energy Council of America v. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
caseNameFull: Consumer Energy Council of America v. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 817.] Motion of petitioner to substitute Consumer Energy Council of America in place of Consumer Federation of America, Energy Policy Task Force, granted.

Mr. Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
